```{r}
library(tidyverse)

rm(list = ls())
df <- read_csv("Base de datos con variables orig e indices cond y vague (49 variables) 2026.csv")
```

# Aggregation

The indicator is composed of behavioural conditions, monitoring and sanctions. Each of these items have a maximum possible score of 7.

For the overall indicator we will do a geometrical mean.

## Behavioral Conditions

### Education

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(cond_edu = case_when(
    edu_mat_asis_res_cond == 0 ~ 0,
    edu_mat_asis_res_cond == 1 ~ 1,
    edu_mat_asis_res_cond == 2 ~ 3,
    edu_mat_asis_res_cond == 3 ~ 5,
    edu_mat_asis_res_cond == 4 ~ 7,
    edu_mat_asis_res_cond == 98 ~ 1,
    edu_mat_asis_res_cond == 99 ~ NA_real_
  ))
```

### Health

For this dimension we considered which age groups were included as target population and weighed the items according to this.

For children aged 6-18 and adults it is a binary variable given that there is not much possible variation on the frequency of check ups demanded.

```{r}
# Check-ups 0-2 yo
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    cond_sal_2 = case_when(
      salud_cont2_cond == 0 ~ 0,
      salud_cont2_cond == 1 ~ 1,
      salud_cont2_cond == 2 ~ 4,
      salud_cont2_cond == 3 ~ 7,
      salud_cont2_cond == 98 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), # Check-ups 2-5 yo
    cond_sal_2_5 = case_when(
      salud_cont25_cond == 0 ~ 0,
      salud_cont25_cond == 1 ~ 1,
      salud_cont25_cond == 2 ~ 4,
      salud_cont25_cond == 3 ~ 7,
      salud_cont25_cond == 98 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), # Check-ups 6-18 yo
    cond_sal_6_18 = case_when(
      salud_cont618_cond == 0 ~ 0,
      salud_cont618_cond %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 7,
      salud_cont618_cond == 98 ~ 7,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), # Check-ups prenatal
    cond_sal_prenatal = case_when(
      salud_cont_pre_nat_cond == 0 ~ 0,
      salud_cont_pre_nat_cond == 1 ~ 4,
      salud_cont_pre_nat_cond == 2 ~ 7,
      salud_cont_pre_nat_cond == 98 ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), # Check-ups adults
    cond_sal_adultos = case_when(
      salud_cont_adult_cond == 0 ~ 0,
      salud_cont_adult_cond %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 7,
      salud_cont_adult_cond == 98 ~ 7,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), # Immunization card
    cond_sal_vacuna = case_when(
      salud_carn_vac_cond == 0 ~ 0,
      salud_carn_vac_cond == 1 ~ 7,
      salud_carn_vac_cond == 99 ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

**Health requirements indicator (update 2022).**

Addition of the score on each health behaviour. Because they all have the same weight for the aggregate health behaviour indicator, we divide the added score between the number of age groups included in the targeted population, as to make them comparable. *count_cond_sal* is built from the sum of the number of times the behavioral condition appears in the base for each case.

```{r}
df <- df %>%
    mutate(
    # counts if there is a conditionality (not NA and >0)
    count_cond_sal_2 = ifelse(!is.na(cond_sal_2) & cond_sal_2 > 0, 1, 0),
    count_cond_sal_2_5 = ifelse(!is.na(cond_sal_2_5) & cond_sal_2_5 > 0, 1, 0),
    count_cond_sal_6_18 = ifelse(!is.na(cond_sal_6_18) & cond_sal_6_18 > 0, 1, 0),
    count_cond_sal_prenatal = ifelse(!is.na(cond_sal_prenatal) & cond_sal_prenatal > 0, 1, 0),
    count_cond_sal_adultos = ifelse(!is.na(cond_sal_adultos) & cond_sal_adultos > 0, 1, 0),
    count_cond_sal_vacuna = ifelse(!is.na(cond_sal_vacuna) & cond_sal_vacuna > 0, 1, 0),
    # suma del número de condiciones
    count_cond_sal = count_cond_sal_2 + count_cond_sal_2_5 + count_cond_sal_6_18 +
      count_cond_sal_prenatal + count_cond_sal_adultos + count_cond_sal_vacuna
  )

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # suma del puntaje de todas las condicionalidades en salud
    score_cond_health = rowSums(select(., starts_with("cond_sal"))),
    # dividido entre el número de condiciones efectivas
    cond_health = score_cond_health / count_cond_sal,
    # Entre 0 y 1
    cond_health_ind = cond_health * (1/7)
  )
```

### Workshops and Labour

```{r}
# WORKSHOPS
df <- df %>%
  mutate(cond_workshops = case_when(
    lab_tall_cond == 0 ~ 0,
    lab_tall_cond == 1 ~ 7,
    lab_tall_cond == 99 ~ NA_real_
  ))

# LABOUR
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    lab_req_cond = as.numeric(lab_req_cond),  # Ensure Lab_Req_Cond is numeric
    cond_labour = case_when(
      lab_req_cond == 0 ~ 0,
      lab_req_cond == 1 ~ 1,
      lab_req_cond == 2 ~ 4,
      lab_req_cond %in% c(3, 4) ~ 7,
      lab_req_cond == 99 ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

### Indicator - Behavior

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    cond_edu_weight = cond_edu * 0.455,
    cond_health_weight = cond_health * 0.455,
    cond_workshops_weight = cond_workshops * 0.045,
    cond_labour_weight = cond_labour * 0.045,

    behaviour = rowSums(cbind(cond_edu_weight, cond_health_weight, cond_workshops_weight, cond_labour_weight), na.rm = TRUE),

    behaviour_ind = behaviour*(1/7)
  )
```

## Monitoring

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    freq = case_when(
      # Frecuencia monitoreo
      frec_cont_mon == 0 ~ 0,
      frec_cont_mon == 1 | frec_cont_mon == 98 ~ 1,
      frec_cont_mon == 2 ~ 3,
      frec_cont_mon == 3 | frec_cont_mon == 4 ~ 5,
      frec_cont_mon == 5 ~ 7,
      frec_cont_mon == 99 ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # MONITORING INDICATOR (just with monitoring frequency - 12/22 update)
    monitoring_ind = freq * (1/7)
  )
```

## Sanctions

### Sanctions Indicator (Dic. 2022)

```{r}
# Recodificar 98 -> 1 y 99 -> NA en todas las variables de sanción (edu, salud, otras)
sanc_vars <- grep("(1er_inc_sanc|2do_inc_sanc|3er_inc_sanc|mas_severa_sanc)$", names(df), value = TRUE)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(sanc_vars),
                ~ ifelse(. == 98, 1, ifelse(. == 99, NA, .))))

# Dejar en missing la sanción si no había condicionalidad asociada
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(c(edu_1er_inc_sanc, edu_2do_inc_sanc, edu_mas_severa_sanc),
                ~ ifelse(edu_mat_asis_res_cond == 0, NA, .)),
         across(c(salud_2_1er_inc_sanc, salud_2_2do_inc_sanc, salud_2_mas_severa_sanc),
                ~ ifelse(salud_cont2_cond == 0, NA, .)),
         across(c(salud_25_1er_inc_sanc, salud_25_2do_inc_sanc, salud_25_mas_severa_sanc),
                ~ ifelse(salud_cont25_cond == 0, NA, .)),
         across(c(salud_618_1er_inc_sanc, salud_618_2do_inc_sanc, salud_618_mas_severa_sanc),
                ~ ifelse(salud_cont618_cond == 0, NA, .)),
         across(c(salud_pre_nat_1er_inc_sanc, salud_pre_nat_2do_inc_sanc, salud_pre_nat_mas_severa_sanc),
                ~ ifelse(salud_cont_pre_nat_cond == 0, NA, .)),
         across(c(salud_adult_1er_inc_sanc, salud_adult_2do_inc_sanc, salud_adult_mas_severa_sanc),
                ~ ifelse(salud_cont_adult_cond == 0, NA, .)),
         across(c(otras_cond_1er_inc_sanc, otras_cond_2do_inc_sanc, otras_cond_mas_severa_sanc),
                ~ ifelse(lab_req_cond == 0 & lab_tall_cond == 0, NA, .)))
# Para el bloque "otras", la condición usada es lab_req_cond == 0 & lab_tall_cond == 0,
# a diferencia de los demás bloques, que usan una variable de "existencia de condición"
# distinta a la de sanción (p. ej. edu_mat_asis_res_cond)

# Asegurar tipo numérico (esta columna venía como character en la base,
# por mezclar el 1 numérico del recode anterior con el resto de los valores)
df$salud_pre_nat_1er_inc_sanc <- as.numeric(df$salud_pre_nat_1er_inc_sanc)

# EDUCATION
df <- df %>%
  mutate(sanc_edu = (edu_1er_inc_sanc + edu_2do_inc_sanc + edu_mas_severa_sanc) / 21) # normalizado 0-1

# HEALTH
# suma de las sanciones a cada grupo por instancias, dividido por el número efectivo de grupos con condiciones
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    sanc_health_1 = ifelse(count_cond_sal == 0, NA, rowSums(select(df, starts_with("salud_") & ends_with("_1er_inc_sanc")), na.rm = TRUE) / (count_cond_sal * 7)),
    sanc_health_2 = ifelse(count_cond_sal == 0, NA, rowSums(select(df, starts_with("salud_") & ends_with("_2do_inc_sanc")), na.rm = TRUE) / (count_cond_sal * 7)),
    sanc_health_most = ifelse(count_cond_sal == 0, NA, rowSums(select(df, starts_with("salud_") & ends_with("_mas_severa_sanc")), na.rm = TRUE) / (count_cond_sal * 7)),
    sanc_health = ifelse(count_cond_sal == 0, NA, (sanc_health_1 + sanc_health_2 + sanc_health_most) / 3)
  )

# OTROS
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    sanc_otros = (otras_cond_1er_inc_sanc + otras_cond_2do_inc_sanc + otras_cond_mas_severa_sanc) / 21
  )

# OVERALL SANCTIONS INDEX
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    sanctions_ind = rowMeans(select(df, c("sanc_health", "sanc_edu", "sanc_otros")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Overall indicator

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    conditionality = (behaviour_ind * monitoring_ind * sanctions_ind)^(1/3)
  )
```

### Vagueness of Rules

```{r}
# Behavioural requirements
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    precise_behaviour = case_when(
      otros_det_exp_cond == 0 ~ 0,
      otros_det_exp_cond == 1 ~ 0.5,
      otros_det_exp_cond == 2 ~ 1
    )
  )

# Monitoring
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    precise_monitoring = case_when(
      det_exp_mon == 0 ~ 0,
      det_exp_mon == 1 ~ 0.5,
      det_exp_mon == 2 ~ 1
    )
  )

# Sanctions (Education)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    precise_sanctions_edu = case_when(
      edu_det_exp_sanc == 0 ~ 0,
      edu_det_exp_sanc == 1 ~ 0.5,
      edu_det_exp_sanc == 2 ~ 1
    )
  )

# Sanctions (Health & others)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    precise_sanctions_health = case_when(
      otros_det_exp_sanc == 0 ~ 0,
      otros_det_exp_sanc == 1 ~ 0.5,
      otros_det_exp_sanc == 2 ~ 1
    )
  )

# Promedio de vaguedad por fila (programa-país-año)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    av_vagueness = rowMeans(
      across(c(precise_behaviour, precise_monitoring,
               precise_sanctions_edu, precise_sanctions_health)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```

# Base final (49 variables)

```{r}
df_reducido <- df %>%
  select(1:which(names(df) == "grupos_po"),
         conditionality, behaviour_ind, monitoring_ind, sanctions_ind, av_vagueness,
         precise_behaviour, precise_monitoring, precise_sanctions_edu, precise_sanctions_health)

write_csv(df_reducido, "Base de datos con variables orig e indices cond y vague (49 variables) 2026.csv")
```
